or [[Dzagonur Bastion]] |followed by = [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh]] }} The three merchant princes of [[Vabbi]] summon you to the [[Halls of Chokhin]]. It's best not to keep them waiting. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * The Princes of Vabbi await you in the Halls of Chokhin. * Defeat the invading forces and protect the [[messenger of Lyssa]]. * Speak with the messenger of [[Lyssa]]. * Hurry to [[the Mirror of Lyss]] and investigate what's happening at the [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh (outpost)|Grand Court of Sebelkeh]]. * Listen to [[General Morgahn|Morgahn]]'s explanation. * See [[Head Priest Vahmani]] for your reward. ===Reward=== * 2,000 [[Experience]] * 250 [[Gold]] * 10 [[Lightbringer rank|Lightbringer Points]] ==Walkthrough== If you have [[Mihanu Township]] unlocked, you can [[map travel]] there and head north to the Hall of Chokhin; however if you don't, it is easiest to leave from the Grand Court of Sebelkeh outpost and head west to Mihanu Township. After you walk near the princes, the quest evolves. You have to protect the Messenger of Lyssa against the four Margonites. After you talked to the messenger, map to the Grand Court of Sebelkeh and enter The Mirror of Lyss through the eastern exit. After talking to Morgahn, you see a cinematic. Now you can enter the [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh]] mission. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== [[Human]]s *{{me}} 20 [[Messenger of Lyssa]] *{{me}} 20 [[Prince Bokka the Magnificent]] *{{x}} 20 [[Prince Ahmtur the Mighty]] *{{x}} 20 [[Prince Mehtu the Wise]] Humans ([[Kournan military]]) (Morgahn and 6 others) *{{p}} 20 [[General Morgahn|Morgahn]] *{{r}} 20 [[Kournan Bowman]] *{{mo}} 20 [[Kournan Priest]] *{{n}} 20 [[Kournan Oppressor]] *{{me}} 20 [[Kournan Seer]] *{{e}} 20 [[Kournan Scribe]] *{{p}} 20 [[Kournan Phalanx]] *{{d}} 20 [[Kournan Zealot]] ===Foes=== [[Demon]]s ([[Margonite]]s) (only 4 will spawn) *{{w}} 24 (26) [[Margonite Executioner]] *{{mo}} 24 (26) [[Margonite Cleric]] *{{n}} 24 (26) [[Margonite Warlock]] *{{me}} 24 (26) [[Margonite Seer]] *{{e}} 24 (26) [[Margonite Sorcerer]] *{{p}} 24 (26) [[Margonite Ascendant]] *{{d}} 24 (26) [[Margonite Reaper]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Zerai the Learner :''"The three merchant '''princes''' of Vabbi summon you to the '''Halls of Chokhin'''. It's best not to keep them waiting."'' {{offer dialog |accept = After all this? We can't just say no. |decline = Let them deal with their problems. |ask = The princes are waiting for you in the Halls of Chokhin. }} ===Intermediate dialogue=== :'''Prince Mehtu the Wise:''' ''"I thank you all for coming here. [[Varesh Ossa|Varesh]]'s assaults thus far were merely distractions. It is atop the temple."'' ==Notes== *If the Messenger of Lyssa dies at any point - even after talking to her - you will have to restart the quest. {{anomaly| During this quest, you can find another Prince Mehtu standing in the left chamber of the halls, in addition to the Prince Mehtu that spawns for the quest.}} {{anomaly| It is possible to skip the first three objectives by talking to Morgahn.}} {{anomaly| When doing this quest in [[Hard Mode]], [[Vabbi Guard]]s are occasionally able to outheal the damage output from the Margonites if a Margonite Cleric is present, causing them to never reach the Halls of Chokhin.}} [[Category:Rewards Lightbringer points]]
